hints.structure: Use the formula: Subject:, Style:, Framing:, Lighting:.
hints.diff: Change at least one of Subject / Style / Framing / Lighting from your last prompt.
hints.vocab: Try using one of today's visual words: concept art, close-up, volumetric lighting, avatar, background, generate, hallucination, fact, detail.
hints.prosRequired: Tell what you like about this image (at least 3 words).
hints.consRequired: Tell what you don't like or what could be improved (at least 3 words).
hints.bestReason: Say why this is your best image.
hints.worstReason: Say why this is your worst image.
hints.empty: Write a prompt - the text instructions you give to the image AI.
hints.accept: You can accept this field once you have at least 3 rated iterations, one best with a reason, and one worst with a reason.
hints.build: Image gates open. You can now generate the next field, or ask your teacher to build your site.

fields.label: Avatar
fields.brief: Pick a prompt that builds a stylized image of YOU - not a photo. Use the formula Subject: ... Style: ... Framing: ... Lighting: ... . Generate at least 3 versions, rate each one (pros/cons), then pick your best and your worst with reasons.
fields.guidance: AI-generated only - no real photos. Transparent background so particles follow the shape. Catch hallucinations (extra fingers, melted hands, wrong details) in your cons and mark that image as worst.

fields.label: Background
fields.brief: A thematic picture that sits behind your avatar - your story, your mood. NO people, NO text, NO watermarks. Use the formula Subject: ... Style: ... Framing: ... Lighting: ... . Generate at least 3 versions, rate each one (pros/cons), then pick your best and your worst with reasons.
fields.guidance: Catch hallucinations (people, readable text, watermarks) in your cons and mark that image as worst - those are AI flaws you must catch as the Operator.
